scripts.start: npm run build && npx tsx apps/api/src/main.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/engine && tsc --noEmit -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/domain/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/db/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:web
scripts.test:node:coverage: npx c8 --reporter=text --reporter=html --all --src packages/engine/src --src packages/domain/src --src packages/db/src --src packages/contracts/src --src packages/client/src --src apps/api/src npx tsx --test 'tests/**/*.test.ts'
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:node:coverage && npm run test:web:coverage
